_comment: No free discovery API exists for ad/media-buying agencies (Clutch and DesignRush have no public API; Meta Ad Library's free tier only covers political/social/housing/credit ads, not general commercial ad spend; Google Custom Search is closed to new signups). Seed this list yourself — from manual research, referrals, or roundup articles you find — and the pipeline enriches + scores each one from its own public site and Twitter presence. Starter batch below is real crypto/web3 marketing and community-management agencies (verified via web search) — add or remove as you find more.
